description: A subset of a finite Cartesian power of a structure is \(A\)-definable if a formula with finitely many parameters from \(A\) defines its membership.
signature:
Set.Definable.{u, v, w, u₁} {M : Type w} (A : Set M) (L : FirstOrder.Language) [L.Structure M] {α : Type u₁}
  (s : Set (α → M)) : Prop
